from typing import Annotated
import cyclopts

def deploy(
    target: str,
    token: Annotated[str, cyclopts.Env("DEPLOY_TOKEN"), cyclopts.Doc("API token")]
) -> None:
    print(f"Deploying to {target} with token {token}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    cyclopts.parse(deploy)
